lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Serial numbers are off a bench, not off a line. Hand-numbered in pencil and then overwritten. Somebody's been walking prototypes out of Meridian in ones and twos for a while.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Take the halo rig. Second one I built, first one that works, and if you tell anyone I gave it away I'll deny it to your face.
